# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A customer scans a QR code printed on the receipt to leave a review. (Mira, 2026-10-21: someday; not this release and not soon. Idea kept so it isn't lost; not designed or scheduled.)
